title.zh: XRPN took shareholder vote with no knowledge of XRP inflation bug
title.en: XRPN took shareholder vote with no knowledge of XRP inflation bug

current_state.zh: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.
current_state.en: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.
